units.source_text: 空蝉近来看见源氏公子已经将她忘记，心中固然高兴，

en.t: Utsusemi had lately seen that Prince Genji had already forgotten her, and in her heart she was of course relieved,

units.source_text: 然而那一晚怪梦似的回忆，始终没有离开心头，使她不能安寝。

en.t: but the memory of that strange, dreamlike night never left her mind, and kept her from sleeping peacefully.

units.source_text: 她白天神思恍惚，夜间悲伤愁叹，不能合眼，今夜也是如此。

en.t: By day her thoughts were dazed and wandering; by night she grieved and sighed, unable to close her eyes, and tonight was the same.

units.source_text: 那个下棋的对手说：“今晚我睡在这里吧。”

en.t: Her partner in the game of Go said, "I will sleep here tonight."

units.source_text: 兴高采烈地讲了许多话，便就寝了。

en.t: She talked cheerfully about many things, then went to bed.

units.source_text: 这年轻人无心无思，一躺下便酣睡。

en.t: This young person had no worries on her mind, and as soon as she lay down she slept soundly.

units.source_text: 这时候空蝉觉得有人走近来，并且闻到一股浓烈的香气，知道有些蹊跷，便抬起头来察看。

en.t: At that moment Utsusemi sensed someone approaching, and also caught a strong fragrance; realizing something was amiss, she raised her head to look.

units.source_text: 虽然灯光幽暗，但从那挂着衣服的帷屏的隙缝里，分明看到有个人在走近来。

en.t: Although the lamplight was dim, through a gap in the curtain screen where clothes were hanging, she could clearly see someone coming toward her.

units.source_text: 事出意外，甚为吃惊，一时不知如何是好。

en.t: It was so unexpected that she was terribly startled, and for a moment she did not know what to do.

units.source_text: 终于迅速起身，披上一件生绢衣衫，悄悄地溜出房间去了。

en.t: At last she quickly rose, slipped on a raw-silk robe, and quietly stole out of the room.
